activity.notes: Tvrtko succeeded Stephen II as Ban of Bosnia in 1353. In February 1366 a magnate revolt expelled him and installed his brother Vuk. Because the surviving evidence does not provide a secure day-level start or deposition boundary for the full reign segment, ATLAS records the conventional 1353-1366 first banate phase at year granularity rather than inventing exact dates.

sources.citation_text: Croatian Encyclopedia identifies Tvrtko as Bosnian ban from 1353 and king from 1377 to 1391.
